priority_1.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 minutes of dynamic stretching. Main set: 45 minutes of continuous, easy-paced running. Keep heart rate strictly below 145 bpm (under 75% of your Max HR of 194). Focus on a high stride cadence (170-180 spm) and light landing. Cool-down: 5 minutes of walking and light calf stretching.
priority_1.reason: This directly targets your 5km running goal, which has been underrepresented in your recent 3-week block, while keeping metabolic stress low enough to promote recovery from yesterday's 80-load performance ride.

priority_2.workout_details:
Warm-up: 10 minutes of dynamic mobility (90/90 hips, worlds greatest stretch). Main Set:
- Barbell Back Squat: 3 sets x 5 reps @ 75% 1RM (heavy but controlled to support cycling torque)
- Overhead Press (OHP): 3 sets x 6 reps
- Heavy Sandbag Carry: 3 sets x 50 meters (core and torso stability)
- Kettlebell Plank Pull-Throughs: 3 sets x 10 reps
priority_2.reason: Allows your cardiovascular system to recover from recent cycling loads while building the raw mechanical strength, torque, and core stability required to support your 5-minute and 20-minute cycling power.

priority_3.workout_details:
Part 1: 25 minutes of ultra-easy spinning on the e-bike (commute intensity, zero resistance, light spinning to flush out lactic acid).
Part 2: 20 minutes of targeted foam rolling and static stretching focusing on hip flexors, hamstrings, glutes, and thoracic spine mobility.
priority_3.reason: If you are feeling extreme local muscular fatigue in your quadriceps from yesterday's quality session, this passive/active recovery combination will accelerate recovery and bring your TSB back toward a positive trend.
